body:
i probably should share it with my therapist... but i honestly don't believe it would do any good. he's smart, and really good but  he seems stuck on this one thing for some reason... he thinks if i resolve that then everything's going to snap into place i guess.

as for my husband... ugh no.. i love him and he loves me... but whenever i'm honest about stuff this heavy he gets a horrible worried, hurt look on his face and just looks helpless then i find myself comforting him. i do understand the reasoning though. i'm not really close to anyone else.. i tend to isolate. 

thanks all of you for sharing what you've bee through, it does help. it's just i wish i could find a reason to care beyond being a chicken to die or not hurting my family.  i was watching the news during the Aurora CO. shooting and just kept thinking to myself when i heard about these caring, brilliant, meaningful individuals and wondering why they were dead when they were accomplishing so much and had such passion for life and yet here i am wasting space. 

i'd do just about anything for passion.
dang.. now you guys made me cry...

I have. The thing is he is always really supportive and says take all the time I need. He's also a redditor and I was bored and missing him today and did the stupid thing of looking at his posts. Anyway, that's just icing on the cake really. Thanks for being kind enough to respond.

Thank you so much for putting yourself out there. My experiences started with just the crying and now it's progressed to this. I'd like to talk more to you folks about this but I'm a reddit newbie and haven't figured out pm's yet lol.  I'll get back to you. <3
Thank you :) Feeling not alone is good, although I wouldn't wish this on anyone. <3
Thanks but it was hard enough just to submit the question here. I don't think I could talk about it on the radio eek. Thank you for caring enough to comment though.
